description: Land Title Settlement Department - Thalvita, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420363
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically modifying land classifications, parcel exclusions, and land extent measurements for various parcels of land in the Kurunegala District. The content falls squarely within land and property-related matters, making it a clear Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than any government personnel or organizational matter.
